stateNote: Divide gluten mass into loaf- or roll-shaped halves. At this point, there are several things you can add to the mass: Soy sauce (recommended): traditional in the making of seitan. Spices: seitan can simulate Italian sausage by adding the correct spices, or adding poultry seasoning can make the seitan more similar to chicken or turkey. Nutritional yeast (recommended): B12 found in some brands of nutritional yeast is a vitamin that is usually obtained through meats, eggs and/or dairy products.
